s01-black-click-pen.note: The clip is followed more cleanly, but 1.10 adds a wavy band of shadow above the barrel.

s02-brass-nameplate.note: Both versions recover the plaque. The 1.10 outline sits slightly farther out and adds small bumps along the long edge.

s03-craftsman-hex-keys.note: Recovers the black side panels instead of tracing only the red handle.

s04-craftsman-tape-measure.note: Recovers the full dark casing and hook as one outline; 1.9 follows red panels and cuts through the reference strip.

s05-dewalt-screwdriver.note: Recovers the dark grip, chuck and rear cap as one outline instead of three colored fragments.

s06-digital-calipers.note: Recovers the reflective beam and connects it to the body. A small bump remains on the beam edge.

s07-needle-clear-hub.note: The clear hub remains split and cut into. Its smoother boundary does not make it a complete tool outline.

s08-needle-pink-hub.note: Connects the pink hub and metal needle into one complete silhouette instead of three fragments.

s09-fanttik-desoldering-pump.note: Includes the pale nozzle and follows the plunger shaft more continuously, with a slightly larger outline.

s10-fanttik-soldering-iron.note: Both recover the body; 1.10 rounds the shoulders and includes the small raised control more fully.

s11-fanttik-stand-arm.note: Connects the reflective curved arm and follows its outer edges instead of splitting the arm at a highlight.

s12-fanttik-stand-base.note: Both recover the round base. The 1.10 boundary is slightly farther outside the rim.

s13-flipper-zero.note: Both recover the case and ignore the reference strip on top; 1.10 rounds the corners more smoothly.

s14-folding-knife.note: Recovers the reflective metal and wood as one silhouette instead of five fragments.

s15-gerber-multitool.note: Smooths the long edges, but adds a pronounced shadow spur at one end and a deeper slit between the handles.

s16-gray-click-pen.note: Both recover the pen; 1.10 removes small edge spikes and rounds the clip and tip.

s17-mini-ratchet.note: Both recover the ratchet, but 1.10 adds an outward step along the handle's shadow.

s18-rub-n-buff.note: Recovers most of the reflective tube instead of just the red label. The white cap is still missing and small foldbacks remain.

s19-ryobi-cutter.note: Recovers the dark grip, end cap and reflective cutting head as one silhouette instead of colored fragments.

s20-flux-syringe-plunger.note: Recovers the clear shaft and thumb pad instead of only the black seal. Spurs remain around the pad and seal.

s21-flux-syringe.note: Connects the syringe body, tip and finger grips, but false interior holes and label-related cuts remain.

s22-stapler.note: Removes jagged shadow edges, but fills much of the visible opening between the stapler arms.

s23-tarkit-mould-line-remover.note: Recovers the blade tip more fully and smooths the handle shadow; the blade notch still needs inspection.

s24-deburring-tool.note: Smooths the handle and metal tip, but includes a prominent spur from the photography support wire.

s25-tweezers.note: Recovers the pale tweezer tip instead of cutting into it at the highlight.

s26-wiha-single-a.note: Recovers the reflective flat shaft and tip instead of leaving a long cut through the shaft.

s27-wiha-single-b.note: Recovers the complete reflective shaft and tip with a continuous outer boundary.

s28-wiha-single-c.note: Recovers the thin shaft and tip instead of following only its dark reflection.

s29-wiha-150mm-1.note: Removes some attached printing and smooths the handle, but the long shaft still splits into three outline pieces.

s30-wiha-150mm-2.note: Reduces attached printing and smooths the shaft and handle; the reflective shaft still has a narrow internal gap.

s31-wiha-150mm-3.note: Recovers the shaft more fully, but adds a tall spur from nearby sheet printing at the cap.

s32-wiha-150mm-4.note: Connects the split shaft and recovers its width; small ripples remain along the long edge.

s33-wiha-150mm-5.note: Connects the three fragments into a continuous shaft and handle, including the tip.

s34-wolfbox-air-duster.note: Removes much of the jagged shadow along the grip and nozzle and produces a smoother silhouette.

s35-wolfbox-cone-nozzle.note: Replaces the large jagged shadow boundary with a much closer, smoother nozzle outline.

s36-wolfbox-long-nozzle.note: Smooths the ribs and removes jagged shadow excursions around the connector shoulders.
